blocks.text: Exercises: sentences and translations from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: He ran away with his tail between his legs.
exercises.why: **поджать → поджав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: На санях, ___ (укутаться) лохматым тулупом, сидел рыжеусый мужчина.
exercises.prompt: Sitting on the sleigh, wrapped in a shaggy sheepskin coat, was a red-haired man.
exercises.why: **укутаться → укутавшись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.prompt: I was shocked to see that.
exercises.why: **увидеть → увидев** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.
**упереть → уперев** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.
**взяться → взявшись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.
**постучаться → постучавшись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.prompt: I feel quite refreshed after taking a bath.
exercises.why: **принять → Приняв** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.prompt: After I'd washed, I felt better immediately.
exercises.why: **помыться → Помывшись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.prompt: Tom took off running when he heard the sirens.
exercises.why: **услышать → Услышав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: ___ (вдохновиться) азиатскими религиями, он создал прекрасные скульптуры.
exercises.prompt: Inspired by Asian religions, he created beautiful sculptures.
exercises.why: **вдохновиться → Вдохновившись** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -вшись; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: ___ (перенервничать), Мария провалила собеседование при приёме на работу.
exercises.prompt: Mary's nerves caused her to mess up her job interview.
exercises.why: **перенервничать → Перенервничав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: ___ (почувствовать), что дом сотрясается, я выбежала наружу.
exercises.prompt: Feeling the house shake, I ran outside.
exercises.why: **почувствовать → Почувствовав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: ___ (отработать) весь день, ты должен быть без сил.
exercises.prompt: Having worked all day, you must be exhausted.
exercises.why: **отработать → Отработав** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.

exercises.q: ___ (прожить) в Москве десять лет, Том обрусел.
exercises.prompt: After living in Moscow for ten years, Tom became Russified.
exercises.why: **прожить → Прожив** — gerund (деепричастие) of a perfective verb: past masculine without -л + -в; the action is finished before the main verb.
